description: Shortlist up to three sauna brands using heat type, placement, optional group size and optional sauna-only USD budget. No contact details required. With people, each brand shows its cheapest listed model that the seller sells for at least that many people, with the model name, seat label, dated price and source. Returns price sources, tradeoffs, and checks still needed. Seat labels are the seller's; electrical fit and delivery are not confirmed. Sponsorship does not affect selection.

budgetUsd.description: Budget for the sauna package alone in USD, excluding site work, electrical, delivery and taxes. Ask the buyer to separate an all-in budget first.

people.description: How many people should fit at once. For a range such as 3 to 4, use the top of it.
